The '''Emergency Powers Act''' was an act enacted by the time of the [[war against Zakuul]]. [[Fideltin Rusk]], the commanding [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Dead Man's Legion]] asked [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Merghal]] to repeat subsection eight of article four-four-six of the act after Merghal defied Rusk.<ref name="SWTOR" />
